name: Claude Code Auto Mode Default — Live Today; AI Safety Beats Human Review
hook: Auto mode went live today (August 14) as the default permission mode for all new Pro, Max, and Team sessions. Instead of prompting you at every step, a classifier blocks any action deemed irreversible, destructive, or outside your environment — and when blocked, Claude usually finds a safer path or asks. Internal tests with 1,053 paid users found auto mode caught 89% of dangerous commands vs 13.6% for human review (humans approve 97% of prompts reflexively). Trajectory Labs ran 720 prompt injection attacks; auto mode blocked all 720. Config: Shift+Tab cycles modes mid-session; set defaultMode or disableAutoMode in managed settings. Enterprise and API follow in September.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 3 — Live today for all Pro/Max/Team plans

name: ayghri/i-have-adhd — ~20.5K Stars; Stop Claude Burying the Answer
hook: ~20,500 stars and climbing fast. A single-purpose Claude Code skill that restructures every response around one rule: answer first, then explain. Ten enforced behaviors — lead with the next action, number multi-step tasks, cap lists at 5 items, end with one specific next step, no preamble, no recap, no closers. Built for ADHD users, but viral because it's how most developers want their agent to respond regardless. Went from ~11K to ~20.5K stars in under a week.
install: See README — install via claude plugin command
